tweets.text: One company absorbed 55 days of new Bitcoin issuance in a single week. Strategy now holds 843,738 BTC — roughly 4% of all Bitcoin that will ever exist — and they're 156K coins from hitting 1 million.
Bitcoin Depot filed Chapter 11 and took 9,000 BTM kiosks offline across 47 states. The largest ATM operator in North America couldn't survive the regulatory wave. State-level bans won.
Schwab opened spot Bitcoin trading to 35 million accounts sitting on $12 trillion in assets. Same day? $635M in ETF outflows. The retail door swings open as institutions rotate out.

Citi is publicly quantifying Bitcoin's quantum risk — and it's worse than Ethereum's. Breaking secp256k1 needs 1,200 logical qubits vs 3,200 for BLS12-381. A Tier-1 bank saying this out loud changes the conversation.
